  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "Critical Failure to Launch",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "section_role": "setup",
          "end_condition": "Artie completes the character creation process and stands in the world of Aethelgard.",

            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "setup",
              "location_start_label": "The Cubicle",
              "location_start": "A gray, soul-crushing corporate cubicle.",
              "location_end_label": "The Cubicle",
              "location_end": "A gray, soul-crushing corporate cubicle.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",

        {

              "hands_off_to": "1:5"

              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_end": "A fenced-off area for new players to practice combat.",

              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",

            {

              "location_end": "A fenced-off area for new players to practice combat.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",

              "outcome": "The tutorial boss is defeated via an unintended mechanical exploit.",
              "end_condition_echo": "The tutorial boss is defeated via an unintended mechanical exploit.",
              "hands_off_to": "1:8"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "section_role": "payoff",
          "end_condition": "Artie identifies the specific rare resources required to stabilize his class.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "setup",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_start": "A fenced-off area for new players to practice combat.",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_end": "A fenced-off area for new players to practice combat.",
              "handoff_mode": "aftermath_relocation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The Boar explodes into loot, but a red warning box appears over Artie’s UI.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["loot explosion", "red warning box", "UI"],
              "outcome": "Artie views his character sheet and sees his 'Instability Meter' at 85%.",
              "hands_off_to": "1:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "type": "development",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_start": "A fenced-off area for new players to practice combat.",
              "location_end_label": "Plains Camp",
              "location_end": "A small campfire on the edge of the starting zone.",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "sheltered",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie retreats to a nearby camp to research his class mechanics in the help menu.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["nearby camp", "help menu", "class mechanics"],
              "outcome": "Artie discovers that his class requires 'Stability Shards' to prevent character deletion.",
              "hands_off_to": "1:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "type": "payoff",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:9",
              "location_start_label": "Plains Camp",
              "location_start": "A small campfire on the edge of the starting zone.",
              "location_end_label": "Plains Camp",
              "location_end": "A small campfire on the edge of the starting zone.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie cross-references the shards with a regional map, finding their location in the Whispering Woods.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["regional map", "Whispering Woods", "Stability Shards"],
              "outcome": "Artie identifies the specific rare resources required to stabilize his class.",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie identifies the specific rare resources required to stabilize his class.",
              "hands_off_to": "2:1"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {

        {

        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "section_role": "development",

              "end_condition_echo": "The Whispering Woods dungeon is rendered completely empty of items and monsters.",

        {

              "hands_off_to": "3:1"
